name: IM73A135V01XTSA1
title: IP57 dust- and water-resistant analog MEMS microphone, differential output, 73 dB(A) SNR, 135 dB SPL AOP
summary: IM73A135V01 is an omnidirectional MEMS microphone with an analog differential output, built on a sealed dual-membrane MEMS element that rates IP57 at component level. Its ASIC holds a low-noise preamplifier and a differential output stage; the supply voltage selects between a normal mode (2.3 to 3.0 V, 73 dB(A) SNR, 135 dB SPL overload) and a low power mode (1.52 to 1.8 V, 71 dB(A), 130 dB SPL). Each unit is calibrated to ±1 dB sensitivity, and the response rolls off at 20 Hz. It comes in a 4 × 3 × 1.2 mm bottom-port LGA package.

circuits.title: Output load configuration
circuits.description: Output load configuration. VDD is decoupled to ground by CVDD next to the microphone. Each output carries a capacitance to ground (Ca on Output +, Cb on Output -) and Cd sits across the pair; Rp and Rn take the two outputs to a common node, VCM, the input common-mode point of the following stage. Ca, Cb and Cd are 100 pF max; Rp and Rn are 25 kΩ typ.
notes: GND covers both ground pads, 4 and 5.

operation.text: A sealed MEMS element with two membranes around a stator feeds an ASIC. The ASIC holds a charge pump that biases the MEMS, a band gap reference, an LDO, calibration, a power mode detector watching VDD, and two amplifiers that drive Output + and Output -.

The ASIC picks its mode from the VDD level. With VDD from 2.3 to 3.0 V it runs in normal mode (170 µA typ, 73 dB(A) SNR, 135 dB SPL AOP); with 1.52 to 1.8 V it runs in low power mode (70 µA typ, 71 dB(A) SNR, 130 dB SPL AOP). After a change of mode is detected the output is undefined for 10 ms typ. Sensitivity is the same in all modes.

VDD should reach its final value, within ±10 %, in 5 ms or less. The output is valid 10 ms typ (30 ms max) after the minimum VDD is reached, in either mode. A brown-out is detected when VDD drops under 1.2 V typ.

The output is differential, biased at 1.35 V typ in normal mode and 0.9 V typ in low power mode, with an output impedance of 250 Ω max (normal) or 500 Ω max (low power). A rise in sound pressure gives a rise in output voltage. The rated load is up to 100 pF from each output to ground and up to 100 pF across the outputs, with 25 kΩ typ from each output to the receiving stage's common-mode node, whose undriven level is 1.3 V typ (normal) or 0.85 V typ (low power).
A 100 nF capacitor from VDD to ground placed next to the VDD pin is needed for full SNR.

Every unit is calibrated in production, which holds sensitivity to ±1 dB (-39 to -37 dBV at 1 kHz, 94 dB SPL). The response is flat down to a 20 Hz roll-off; the flat response and the tight tolerance improve multi-microphone arrays. Pickup is omnidirectional.

Because both membranes are sealed, dust and water cannot get between membrane and backplate, so the part meets IP57 on its own: IP5x with Arizona A4 coarse dust and IPx7 with 30 minutes under 1 m of water. A product built around it can reach IP68 with only light mesh protection.

The hole through the board must be wider than the microphone's own port; 0.8 mm diameter (0.4 mm radius) is the recommended size. The land pattern uses solder-mask-defined pads: four 0.75 × 0.45 mm signal pads on a 1.7 × 0.7 mm grid and a copper ring of 1.04 mm outer and 0.58 mm inner radius round the port. The stencil uses four 0.65 × 0.4 mm openings and splits the ring into six segments (outer radius 1, inner 0.6, 0.12 mm webs). Radii not given are 0.2 mm.

Qualified to IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020D-01 at moisture sensitivity level 1. Forced-convection reflow is the intended process, using the profile the solder paste supplier gives, kept within the limits of the reflow table (260 °C peak lead-free). The part survives three reflow passes.

Ordinary placement machines handle it; keep the placement force moderate. Keep vacuum nozzles off the port and never apply vacuum or blown air to it; seal the port if the line cleans boards with blown air. No air-blow or ultrasonic cleaning may be applied to the microphone itself, and cleaning agents can badly damage the MEMS, so use no-clean paste and skip cleaning. Assembly in a clean room avoids contamination, and tape over the port keeps it clear while boards are sawn or the product is put together.
Qualified for industrial use; ready for validation to the applicable IEC 60747 and IEC 60749 tests, or else to JEDEC47/20/22.
Tape and reel: 12 mm carrier tape, 8 mm pocket pitch, 4 mm sprocket-hole pitch, pockets 3.3 × 4.3 mm and 1.4 mm deep, tape 0.25 mm thick. Pin 1 marking faces the sprocket-hole side of the pocket.
